_inferred_marker: Fields whose value was inferred from copy/stats rather than sourced from the sample or scored data carry a sibling key <field>__inferred: true.

_families_note: families derived from the finished copy: arousal + attachment read directly from each archetype's result word; initiation (direct=heard-too-loudly vs indirect=lost-in-translation) from the scalability doc; energy mapped from arousal family (responsive->wave, spontaneous->spike, contextual->conditional) and insecurity_direction (self vs outward monitoring) are INFERRED — confirm against the v5 scoring model. Chart geometry (curves/dots/meters) remains null and is sourced from the Figma components.

_decisions_2026_07_30.1_families_source: RATIFIED: families for all 14 derived from the report chapter masters (ch.8 attachment, ch.9 insecurity, ch.13 energy, ch.15 power, ch.21 arousal, ch.22 initiation). No longer provisional. If v5 scoring later disagrees it is a one-line change per archetype.
_decisions_2026_07_30.2_insecurity: 6 cue families: absence, abandonment, evaluation, engulfment, depletion, destabilisation. families.insecurity_direction REMOVED, replaced by families.insecurity_cue. Each family owns its x-axis label too.
_decisions_2026_07_30.3_attachment: 3 values only: secure-anxious, secure-avoidant, avoidant. secure / secure-contextual / secure-mixed removed - ch.8 assigns none of them. Spiritual Lover is secure-anxious.
_decisions_2026_07_30.4_power: Power is NOT a family system - 14 unique positions on a 2-axis map. families.power_zone is a region label only. The map must name ONLY the reader own dot; the other 13 stay anonymous.
_decisions_2026_07_30.5_importance: 3 bands (Low / Medium / High) in importance_strip.band. The band description is UNIVERSAL - one text per band, not per archetype. The archetype dot is labelled on the strip.
_decisions_2026_07_30.6_beliefs: Spark Seeker 4th positive belief = "Playfulness is real intimacy" (ch.11 has it as prose, not a quote). Kept as written.
_decisions_2026_07_30.7_relational_nurturer_iconBg: null in production; Eman to set at build.
